Both edited manuscripts rebuilt successfully; final logs and 19 Part I / all 12 overview rendered pages checked. GitHub saving is confirmed separately.
current_revision.mathematical_scope: Positive incidence-star topology and intrinsic product; global weighted coordinate barriers; exact ambient closed-ball product when m_alpha>2A, uniform in the residual center; finite-cell classification, residual-center error delta_j, and realization of all pointed types for every prescribed rescaling sequence. Direct finite-cone polar-distance proof without CAT or connected-link assumptions, uniform coarse-section divergence error (K+2A_s)/r, recovery of truncated and extended length metrics, section independence and naturality under pointed cone isometries. Explicit obstructions to a global closed-star product and to identifying all rough rays modulo bounded distance. Metric-link data do not recover divisor labels, chosen cells or depth weights. Existing reviewed distance/measure results remain in place; no family-uniform or genuine-geodesic-boundary conclusion is added.
current_revision.not_verified: No exhaustive proof audit of all Part I claims, Parts II-III or the external surface theorem. No new proof of family-uniform CP/PBE/TC, H_loc/H_anc, controlled push-off or a genuine geodesic-ray boundary theorem. No formal proof, external referee review or exhaustive novelty investigation. External literature proofs were not audited in full. Existing exact/numerical certificate suites were not rerun.
